major_issues.issue: 稻壳菌素（momilactone）途径中间体名称在多处写错：将原文的 "syn-paramidien-6-ol" 错误写成 "syn-pimaradien-6-ol"。pimaradiene 是已知的另一种二萜名称（与 momilactone 途径无关），不属于此处的氧化中间体。
major_issues.source_locator: 原文 p.10 Results 末段："Quantification of the log2 fold change in syn-paramidien-6-ol when momilactone early pathway enzymes..."；Figure 5b 图注同此（page 20 裁剪图 y 轴标签亦清晰显示 "syn-paramidien-6-ol"）。草稿 0/3 号位置：图 5 描述段及图注列表。
major_issues.correction: 将文中所有 "syn-pimaradien-6-ol" 一律更正为 "syn-paramidien-6-ol"（momilactone 早期途径的真实可量化产物名称）。

minor_issues.issue: 所有 Figure 1–6 的裁剪图顶部均连带 bioRxiv preprint 页眉文字（约位于 y ≈ 0.05–0.09），属于裁剪冗余；建议 top 由 0.10 收紧到约 0.13 使裁剪仅含图表本体与图注。
minor_issues.source_locator: 用户提供的"拟插入 Figure N"裁剪图中第 13/14/16/18/20/21 页的顶部区域均可见 "bioRxiv preprint doi..." 二行小字。

minor_issues.issue: limonin 中间体名在草稿中拼写不一致：图 5 描述段写 "dihydroniloticin"（与原文 Methods 和 Figure 5d caption 一致），但 Figure coverage 处又写 "dihydronilocticin"。原文统一为 "dihydroniloticin"。
minor_issues.source_locator: 原文 p.20 Figure 5d caption 与 p.27 Methods 段 "Dihydroniloticin analysis followed the protocol..."

verified_claims.claim: FoTO1 在脂质体中以紫杉二烯-4(5)-环氧化物（2c）为底物，kcat = 69 ± 5 s⁻¹、Km = 30 ± 7 µM，使用 7 个浓度（4–200 µM）测得，三次独立重复。
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.4 Results；Figure 1d（page 13 裁剪图可见 kcat、Km 数值）。
verified_claims.evidence: "FoTO1 turns over its epoxide substrate with a kcat of 69 ± 5 sec-1 and a Km of 30 ± 7 µM (Figure 1c; Supplementary Fig 3). To investigate whether FoTO1 is specific ... calculated using 7 different concentrations of epoxide substrate (4μM - 200μM) in liposomes"

verified_claims.claim: FoTO1 失活突变体 D149A 与 Y60A 在植物中与 chlTDS+T5αH+HMGR/GGPPS 共表达仍使 taxadien-5α-ol 产量相对无 FoTO1 对照提升约 3 倍。
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.6 Results；Figure 2c（page 14 裁剪图）。
verified_claims.evidence: "expression of the FoTO1 catalytic mutants D149 or Y60A in combination with T5αH, TDS, and boost enzymes in planta resulted in a reproducible 3-fold increase in taxadien-5α-ol and a slight, but non-significant increase in relevant side products (iso-OCT, OCT) ... (Figure 2c, Supplementary Fig 10)"

verified_claims.claim: 以 T10βH-Myc 为诱饵，T10βH 显著拉下 T5αH（≈7%）与 FoTO1（≈15%）；用柑橘 CsCYP71CD1 替换 T5αH 后 T10βH 不再拉下 FoTO1。
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.8 Results；Figure 3k–m（page 16 裁剪图）。
verified_claims.evidence: "Pulldown of T10βH led to the statistically significant co-pulldown of T5αH (7%) and FoTO1 (15%) (Figure 3k-l) ... when T5αH was substituted for a cytochrome P450 from Citrus, T10βH was no longer able to pull down FoTO1 nor the Citrus cytochrome P450 ... (Figure 3m)"

verified_claims.claim: TurboID-FoTO1 在 N. benthamiana 中前 100 个富集的内源蛋白中：ER 蛋白 36、质体表面 16、核 12；对照 TurboID-only 仅 4 个为 ER 蛋白。
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.7 Results；Figure 3d（page 16 裁剪图）。
verified_claims.evidence: "thirty-six out of the top hundred enriched proteins localizing to the ER (Figure 3d). In contrast, only four of the top hundred proteins labelled by the TurboID control were ER-localized ... sixteen of the top one hundred significantly enriched TurboID-FoTO1 hits were localized to the surface of the plastid"

verified_claims.claim: FoTO1 与 FoTO1-D149A 在毛喉素（forskolin）途径均使 11-oxo-13R-manoyl oxide 提升约 3 倍；在稻壳菌素（momilactone）与赤霉素（GA12）途径均约 2–3 倍；AtFoTO 同源物无效；胞质定位三萜柠檬苦素途径无提升。
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.10 Results；Figure 5a–d（page 20 裁剪图）：forskolin 有 **、*** 标记；momilactone 有 *、**；GA12 散点间未画显著性线；limonin 有 ***。
verified_claims.evidence: "there is a 3-fold increase in the production of the forskolin intermediate 11-oxo-13R-manoyl oxide ... a similar 2 to 3-fold increase in yield ... did not lead to an observed yield increase ... a FoTO1 homolog from A. thaliana does not"

verified_claims.claim: 催化残基 D149 与 D68 双天冬氨酸对 FoTO1 体外将 taxadiene-4(5)-epoxide 转化为 taxadien-5α-ol 不可或缺；D149E/D68E 部分恢复，Y60F 保留但 Y60A 失活。
verified_claims.evidence: "mutation of either D149 or D68 to alanine completely abrogated the ability of FoTO1 to transform taxadiene-4(5)-epoxide into taxadien-5α-ol in vitro (Figure 2b) ... D68N and D149N had significant accumulation of iso-OCT and OCT ... D68E and D149E resulted in the partial recovery ... Y60A abolished catalytic function but Y60F did not"
